annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Fully implement a negative list management system for cross-border trade in services
Align with RCEP, CPTPP and WTO domestic regulation reference paper
Facilitate cross-border flow of talent, capital, technology and data under the national data export security framework
Implement services trade standardization action plan
Provide financial, tax and insurance support and improve statistics monitoring
annotation.summary_en: Opinion of the General Office of the State Council (Guobanfa [2024] No. 44) on promoting high-quality services trade development through high-level opening up. It sets out a negative list system, rule alignment, cross-border flows of talent, capital, technology and data, key sector development, and supporting policies. AI is mentioned only in passing.
annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于以高水平开放推动服务贸易高质量发展的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Promoting High-Quality Development of Trade in Services through High-Level Opening-Up
annotation.venue: 国务院办公厅 (State Council General Office)
